## Frequently asked questions

### Where is The Plank?
No: 48/26, Mathiravedu Village, Thiruverkadu, near Mehta Hospital, Chennai 600 077.

### What facilities does The Plank have?
2, 3, 4 & 5 BHK interiors, Villa interiors, Bungalow interiors, Architecture, Modular kitchens, Wardrobes, Hospital interiors, Salon & spa interiors, Own production with German machinery, Dedicated project manager.

### Who leads The Plank?
The Plank is headed by its CEO, Ar. Hema, an architect with a passion for functional and beautiful design.

### Do you make the furniture yourselves?
Yes. The production team cuts materials on state-of-the-art German machinery before the implementation team installs on site.

### How do I book a consultation with The Plank?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 82205 77577. Open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 6 pm.
